FEATURE / ARCHITECTURE ISSUE: Restore the module API/runtime boundary between `Game.Structures` and `VoxelEngine.Structures`, and extend the repository architecture test so production modules cannot directly depend on another module's private implementation assembly.

OBSERVED VIOLATION: `Assets/Game/Structures/Runtime/Game.Structures.Runtime.asmdef` directly references `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime`. `Assets/Game/Structures/Runtime/CastleCaveAuthoring.cs` depends on `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime.CaveAuthoring` and `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime.CaveAuthoringResult`, so this is an actual source-level implementation dependency rather than only stale assembly metadata. The dependency was introduced by commit `c651ae380a29a658b160e5e2eb73bd0be9a09476` (`WB049 reference shared cave runtime from game structures`).

REQUIRED FIX: `Game.Structures.Runtime` must depend on `VoxelEngine.Structures.Api`, never `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime`. Introduce the minimum cave-authoring capability in `VoxelEngine.Structures.Api`: an API-owned result contract and a narrow semantic authoring interface (conceptually `CaveAuthoringResult` plus `ICaveAuthoring`) preserving the current call semantics: author a cave from `IStructureAuthoringSession`, `CaveGenerationRequest`, `CaveConfig`, and `CaveMaterialPalette`. The deterministic cave implementation and `CaveNetworkAuthoringCore` remain owned by `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime`. Composition/bootstrap, which is allowed to know concrete runtimes, constructs the runtime implementation and injects the API capability into the Game.Structures castle authoring path. Thread that dependency through the existing castle construction path rather than using a service locator, static global, reflection, or moving engine implementation code into Game. Remove the `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` reference from `Game.Structures.Runtime.asmdef`.

DO NOT FIX BY: whitelisting this particular dependency; making `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` generally public to Game; moving `CaveNetworkAuthoringCore` or other algorithm implementation into the Api assembly; duplicating the cave generator in Game.Structures; moving game castle/campaign policy into VoxelEngine; introducing a new parallel cave generator; using reflection or assembly loading to bypass the compile-time boundary.

ARCHITECTURE TEST REQUIRED: Extend `Assets/VoxelEngine/CI/Editor/EngineGameDependencyBoundaryTests.cs` (or factor a reusable helper used by it) to enforce the repository-wide production-module rule, not only the existing one-way `VoxelEngine -> !Game` rule. The test must parse repository `.asmdef` files and resolve repository-owned assembly references. For production assemblies under `Assets/Game/<Module>` and `Assets/VoxelEngine/<Module>`, a reference to another module is allowed only through that target module's public Api assembly, except for narrow documented categories such as Composition/bootstrap wiring, Editor/Test assemblies, and intentional foundation/shared primitives. Same-module implementation references remain allowed. The validator must report source assembly/path and forbidden target assembly/path. It must reject a fixture equivalent to `Game.Structures.Runtime -> VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` and accept `Game.Structures.Runtime -> VoxelEngine.Structures.Api`. Do not implement this as a source-string assertion for this one assembly name.

OWNERSHIP RULE: `Game.Structures` owns castle/game-semantic structure policy and material mapping. `VoxelEngine.Structures.Api` owns public structure/cave authoring contracts. `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` owns deterministic generic cave/structure implementation. Composition owns construction/wiring of concrete Runtime implementations.

ACCEPTANCE:
(1) `Game.Structures.Runtime.asmdef` has no reference to `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime`.
(2) No source in `Game.Structures` references a `VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` namespace/type.
(3) Castle cave authoring still delegates to the single shared VoxelEngine cave implementation; there is no duplicated cave algorithm.
(4) The cave authoring contract needed by Game.Structures is exposed narrowly through `VoxelEngine.Structures.Api`, with implementation remaining in Runtime.
(5) Concrete runtime construction/wiring occurs only at an allowed composition/bootstrap boundary and is injected through the API contract.
(6) The existing castle cave behavior remains deterministic and existing cave/castle behavioral tests continue to pass.
(7) Add a focused regression proving the Game castle cave adapter maps its semantic request/config/material palette through the API capability without requiring the concrete engine Runtime assembly.
(8) Expand the existing architecture test suite so a future production cross-module `*.Runtime`/private implementation dependency fails automatically across Game and VoxelEngine modules, with same-module/API/composition/test/editor/foundation rules handled explicitly.
(9) The architecture validator includes a focused rule-level regression that rejects `Game.Structures.Runtime -> VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime` and accepts the corresponding `.Api` dependency; the final repository-wide scan passes after the violation is removed.
(10) Preserve the existing `VoxelEngineAssemblies_DoNotReferenceGameAssemblies` and Structures material-ownership protections; do not weaken existing architecture rules.
(11) Inspect all repository-owned `.asmdef` violations surfaced by the expanded rule. Fix in-scope violations required to make the invariant truthful; do not silently blanket-whitelist unrelated runtime dependencies. If additional violations represent materially separate ownership work, record them explicitly and use the narrowest justified exception only when the dependency category is intentionally allowed by this issue (Composition/bootstrap, Tests/Editor, Foundation/shared primitives).
(12) Relevant focused EditMode architecture/Structures tests and automatically derived module validation pass on the exact feature SHA before closure.
resolutionSummary: Restored the Structures module API/runtime boundary by exposing narrow semantic cave/component/inspection contracts from VoxelEngine.Structures.Api, keeping deterministic cave/structure execution in VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime, and injecting concrete Runtime services only from Composition/bootstrap into Game.Structures. Removed the Game.Structures and WorldGen production dependencies on VoxelEngine.Structures.Runtime, migrated representation-only helpers to Api without changing Unity GUIDs, and expanded the repository-wide asmdef validator to reject cross-module private implementation dependencies while explicitly handling same-module, Api, Composition, Test/Editor, Unity TestAssemblies, GUID references, and narrow Foundation cases.
